access: All three filter values must match exactly. Resolve tenant and customer from authenticated claims and server-side entitlement mapping, and validate the requested product against the same entitlement. Fail closed when any value is missing. Search RBAC controls the caller's access to the index; the server constructs and enforces the document filter.
odata: tenantId eq '<trusted tenant>' and customerId eq '<trusted customer>' and product eq '<authorized product>' and isCurrent eq true
provenance: Module 09 Phase A m09-embed-02 recording. Index and query use vectors for exactly the recorded text. Embed changed text against the same deployment before using it.
